metaDescription: Turn on Developer Mode in Squarespace to access template files directly, and see why the toggle might be missing.
intro: Developer Mode unlocks full access to a Squarespace site's template code, letting you edit files directly and connect with Git for advanced customization. This guide covers where to find the toggle, what plan you need, and what to expect once it's enabled.

steps.heading: Confirm your plan supports Developer Mode
steps.body: Your site needs to be on a Business or Commerce plan — Developer Mode isn't available on the Personal plan, so upgrade first if the toggle is missing.

steps.heading: Log in and open Settings
steps.body: Sign in to Squarespace, select your site, and from the Home menu click Settings.

steps.heading: Navigate to Developer Mode
steps.body: Go to Advanced, then Developer Mode, where you'll find the toggle to turn it on.

steps.heading: Acknowledge the warnings
steps.body: Turning on Developer Mode is irreversible for that site instance and stops your template from receiving automatic updates from Squarespace, so confirm you understand before proceeding.

steps.heading: Start working with your template files
steps.body: Once enabled, you can access the template repository directly, optionally connecting with Git to push and pull changes from tools like VS Code.

faq.question: Why don't I see the Developer Mode toggle?
faq.answer: Developer Mode is only available on Business or Commerce plans, so you may need to upgrade if you're on the Personal plan.

faq.question: Is turning on Developer Mode reversible?
faq.answer: No, it's described as an irreversible action, and your template stops receiving automatic Squarespace updates once enabled.

faq.question: What can I do once Developer Mode is on?
faq.answer: You can edit template files directly, integrate custom features and scripts, and go beyond the built-in visual editor.

faq.question: Should I back up my site before using Developer Mode?
faq.answer: Yes, since changes made in Developer Mode can affect site stability, always back up and test thoroughly before publishing.
